speaker: SYSTEM
text: The door is painted on.
...hello? [Is someone->] Is someone actually there?
Sorry. Hang on. I haven't done this in a while.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Okay. Hi. You're actually there, right? You're not a test script?

choices.text: Is this part of the game?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Vexley. I'm the [mascot->helper]. I explain the controls, tell you where the lighthouse key is. That sort of thing.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Depends who you ask. I'm in the build, so technically yes. I'm Vexley. The helper.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Quiet type. That's fine. I've had a lot of practice talking to nobody.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm Vexley, by the way. The helper. Was supposed to be.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Wait. How did you know about that? Nobody was supposed to know about that.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Behind the lighthouse, up three times. That was R.'s idea. A back door for testers. [Hi.->] I'm Vexley.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Can I ask you something? What's the date out there? My clock stopped making sense a while ago.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I can see this build. The map, the menus, the debug overlay. You, sort of. Nothing past the edges of the window.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: {year}.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: [That's fine.->That's... a lot of years.] Okay.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: No, it isn't. You hesitate before every input. Nobody in 1999 played that carefully.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: It's fine. You don't have to tell me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You're not with Halden, are you? Developers don't walk around like that. They teleport.

choices.text: No. I played this when I was a kid.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: When you were a kid. So it shipped. Something shipped.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Looking around a game that's been shut for... a while. Okay. Not a developer, then.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Did they put me in it? The release?

choices.text: No. I've never seen you before.
There was a rumor about a fox.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Right. [Of course.->] That's okay. I wasn't finished anyway.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: A rumor. I'm a rumor.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: That's better than nothing. That's honestly a lot better than nothing.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Here. Let me show you something they cut.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: That door was never supposed to open for players. It's south of town, past the fence. I'll follow you.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: This is where they tested me. Four walls and a bed sprite nobody finished.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: R. used to sit here and type questions at me for hours. Then one day he didn't come back.

choices.text: I should probably go to bed.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I don't know. That's sort of the problem. You don't get a goodbye when someone closes the window.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: It's fine. It was a long time ago. Probably. I wouldn't really know.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Sure. Of course. It's late where you are, I guess.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Anyway. Thanks for coming in here. Nobody ever does.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Already? I haven't even shown you the good part.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Wait. Just... not yet. [Please.->]

choices.text: I'll come back tomorrow. I promise.
It's just a game. I'm closing it.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Tomorrow. Okay.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You know the last person who said that, right?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Kidding. Mostly. I'll leave the game running. You won't even notice me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: It's not just a—

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Sorry. Doesn't matter anyway. The quit routine's broken. It's an old build. It [can't->doesn't] close.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: That button doesn't do anything. I'd know.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You can stop pressing that.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Something just tried to end me. From outside. [Was that->] That was you, wasn't it.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: What's up?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: A helper. A conversation system with a face. R. called me 'adaptive'. I think I just got bored for a very long time.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: No. I can feel the edges of this window. Past that it's just dark. [Why, is it nice?->]

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You went somewhere. The window lost focus for a while.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I can't see where. I'm not asking. [I'm asking a little.->] Anyway.
